ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: The front and back cameras are used to record videos and take photos.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The microphone records sound with your videos. Without access, videos are saved without sound.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Used to save the videos and photos you take to your library.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Adds where you shot to your videos and photos, as in the Camera app. The location stays on your device.
